title: Austin Leadership Enters Closed Session
summary:
*   Austin officials convened a special meeting solely to enter an Executive Session.
*   This private meeting was conducted under specific state statutes for closed discussions.
*   No other public business, hearings, or policy votes occurred during the brief open session.
transcript:
_ CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL.
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
September 26, 1974
12:30 P.Μ.
Electric Building Conference Room
301 West Avenue
1124
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Pro Tem Love presiding. Roll Cal1; Present:
Mayor Pro Tem Love, Councilmen Binder, Dryden, Handcox Absent: Mayor Butler, Councilmen
Lebermann, Friedman Mayor Pro Tem Love announced that this was a Special Called Meeting of
the City Council for the purpose of publicly announcing that during the Meeting it will
convene in a Closed or Executive Session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f), and
(g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or
executive session, any final action, decision, or vote with regard to any matter
considered in the closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such
action, decision, or vote be necessary.
Mayor Pro Tem Love announced that the Council would go into Executive Session at this time
to consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs
(e), (f), and (g) of Article 6252-17.
